name: Land or close fix/large-file-inline-comments to freeze the rule set before extraction (A0)
description:
## Why

The rule-unification track extracts `shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config`'s rule set into three published npm packages (`A1` ports it to ESLint 9 flat config, `A2` extracts and publishes). Both slices operate on the rule set as a whole, and their safety argument rests on the 53-fixture selftest staying green across what should be a move plus packaging metadata — no rewrite.

The branch `fix/large-file-inline-comments` in the config repo is editing the very layers about to be extracted. Per the plan (`doc/plans/rule-unification.md:133-135`) it:

- makes `max-lines` a **blocker** (a severity change, so it changes the severity→gate mapping), and
- **drops warnings from inline comments**.

Extracting on top of a moving rule set means the "baseline preserved" claim `A1` must prove and `A2` must publish has no fixed referent. That is the entire reason slice `A0` exists.

This system's worst failure mode is **fail-green** — a gate that reports zero blockers while looking healthy — so a rule set that shifts mid-extraction is not a cosmetic problem.

## What

1. Land or close `fix/large-file-inline-comments` (branch exists in `shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config`, currently **no open PR**: https://github.com/shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config/tree/fix/large-file-inline-comments).
2. Tell whoever owns it that an extraction is coming, so the work isn't duplicated or stranded.
3. Do the same for the other in-flight branches touching those layers.
4. Then snapshot the exact `rule@severity` set as the baseline `A1` must preserve and `A2` must publish.

## Blast radius

The track order is fixed — **A0 → A1 → A2 → B1 → B2 → B3 → A3/B4** (`doc/plans/rule-unification.md:89`) — and every slice must leave both repos green and shippable, which the plan states as a hard constraint rather than a preference. `A0` is first, so nothing else on the track can start: not the ESLint 8 → 9 flat-config port (`A1`), not the publish (`A2`, tracked separately as the `@shoptet` scope access request), and none of `shoptet/partner-cli`'s B1–B4.

Downstream, `B3` deletes this repo's 12 rules across `packages/eslint-config`, `packages/stylelint-config` and `packages/stylelint-plugin-fragile-selectors` — including `shoptet/datalayer-schema` and `shoptet/no-load-order-globals` — on the strength of the published packages covering them. The frozen baseline is what makes that deletion checkable.

## References

- `doc/plans/rule-unification.md:133-135` — the blocker as recorded
- `doc/plans/rule-unification.md:89` — the slice order and the green/shippable constraint
- `doc/plans/rule-unification.md:99` — the `A0` row: _"land the in-flight branches, freeze the rule set"_
- `doc/plans/rule-unification-b3.md:24-33` — the 12 rules B3 deletes
- PRs carrying the plans: shoptet/partner-cli#27 and shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config#14

## Done when

No in-flight branch is editing the rule set, and the `rule@severity` baseline snapshot is committed in the config repo, so `A1` can start against a fixed referent.
